## Problem and change

Explain the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. Explain any remaining failures or checks
that were not run; distinguish synthetic fixtures from real-data evaluation.

- [ ] Relevant tests, format/type checks and generated-code checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, raw wildlife data, private photos or model binaries are included.
- [ ] New data has exact provenance, license clearance and publication-safe outputs.
- [ ] Scientific claims match measured evidence; limitations remain visible.
- [ ] User-facing changes include responsive/accessibility checks where applicable.

## Risks and follow-up

Record migration/deployment implications, compatibility concerns and unfinished work.
